# Crystal Seed Tarot

> Tarot readings, party and event readings, and tarot lessons in Portland, OR and Vancouver, WA. Reading professionally since 2008.

Crystal Seed Tarot is the practice of Holly, a professional tarot reader serving the Portland, Oregon and Vancouver, Washington area. The work covers three things: one-on-one readings, live reading at parties and corporate events, and teaching people to read for themselves.

## What she offers

- **Private readings.** One-on-one sessions, in person or remote, for people working through a decision, a transition, or a question they keep circling.
- **Party and event reading.** Live tarot at weddings, corporate events, birthdays, and markets. Guests get short individual readings across the event.
- **Tarot lessons and classes.** Beginner through advanced instruction, taught in person and as scheduled group classes.

## How to reach her

- Contact and booking: https://crystalseedtarot.com/contact
- Services and pricing: https://crystalseedtarot.com/services
- Client reviews: https://crystalseedtarot.com/reviews
- Upcoming events and classes: https://crystalseedtarot.com/events

## Common questions

**Where is Crystal Seed Tarot located?** Portland, Oregon, serving the greater Portland metro and Vancouver, Washington. Remote readings are available outside that area.

**Does she read at private events?** Yes. Party and event reading is a core part of the practice, and it covers weddings, corporate events, and private parties.

**Does she teach?** Yes. Tarot lessons run from complete beginner through advanced work, both individually and as group classes listed on the events page.

**How long has she been reading?** Professionally since 2008.
